Messages.Author: Phi
Messages.Body: What is the highest bleed one can manage and how is it done?

Messages.Author: Larry Harriman
Messages.Body:
David Paven (David...@scinfo.u-nancy.fr) wrote:
: Larry Harriman (la...@bu.edu) wrote:
: : Phi (baa...@cs.utwente.nl) wrote:
: : : What is the highest bleed one can manage and how is it done?

: : There is no limit.

: No, sorry, because :

: Mask of 1,000 Faces: Action Modifier
: Only usable by an untapped vampire other than an acting minion you
: control. Untap the acting minion and tap this vampire. Now the newly
: tapped vampire is the acting minion and the action resumes where it
: left off. ^^^^^^^^^^^VVVVVVV^^^^^^^^^
: ^^^^^^^^

: It's the SAME ACTION with a other vampire, so action modifiers
: are still in play and the new acting vampire can play the same action
: modifiers, EXCEPT FOR BONDING, CONDITIONING AND THREATS.

: Conditioning: Action Modifier
: No more than 1 of Bonding, Conditioning, or Threats can be played
: in a single action.
: ^^^^^^^^^^^^^

: VyGER
True, if you play conditioning, you can't play bonding, or threats. However,
nothing stops you from playing another conditioning except for the "one action
modifier per minion" rule. MoaTF sneaks around that rule. Many people (
myself included ) disagree with that rule, but that IS the official
interpretation.

Larrx...

Messages.Author: Larry Harriman
Messages.Body:
Phi (baa...@cs.utwente.nl) wrote:
: What is the highest bleed one can manage and how is it done?

There is no limit.

Gilbert bleeds you, conditioning...
Fooled you, it was Lucien, conditioning...
Fooled you, it was Muriel, conditioning...
Fooled you, it was Justine, conditioning...
Fooled you, it was Ozmo, with a laptop, J. S. Simmons Esq., Tasha Morgan,
Pulse of the Canaille, the Spying Mission from last round, oh, and he's trying
to Govern the Unaligned, conditioning...

That's a twenty-eight point bleed. Sorry.

Larrx...
Why did they do that to Mask of a Thousand Faces?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
David...@scinfo.u-nancy.fr (David Paven) writes:

>Mask of 1,000 Faces: Action Modifier
> Only usable by an untapped vampire other than an acting minion you
> control. Untap the acting minion and tap this vampire. Now the newly
> tapped vampire is the acting minion and the action resumes where it
> left off. ^^^^^^^^^^^VVVVVVV^^^^^^^^^
> ^^^^^^^^

> It's the SAME ACTION with a other vampire, so action modifiers
>are still in play and the new acting vampire can play the same action
>modifiers, EXCEPT FOR BONDING, CONDITIONING AND THREATS.

>Conditioning: Action Modifier
> No more than 1 of Bonding, Conditioning, or Threats can be played
> in a single action.
> ^^^^^^^^^^^^^

> VyGER
'Course, we'd all agree with the logic, but the Design Team has
interpretted the statement to mean: only one *type* of Bonding,
Conditioning, or Threats can be played... allowing you to play
as many of any *one* type as you have vampires playing Mask1K.

The DT apparently likes Munchkin rules.
